title: OpenClaw GitHub Automation: PR Reviews, Issue Triage, and Release Notes on Autopilot
summary: Set up OpenClaw as a 24/7 GitHub agent — it reviews PRs, triages issues, writes release notes, and monitors dependencies while you sleep. Setup guide for 2026.
body_markdown: You define it in` SOUL.md` . Your team might use the "ready for review" label, or the GitHub "ready for review" PR status, or a specific Slack message. The agent reads whatever signal you document in` SOUL.md` and acts accordingly. The[openclaw-skills-for-developers guide](https://blink.new/blog/openclaw-skills-for-developers) has patterns for customizing these rules to your workflow.
